paylocity_new_company_shift_trigger.description: Runs when new company shift is observed in Paylocity. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

paylocity_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs when new employee is observed in Paylocity. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

paylocity_new_or_updated_company_shift_t.description: Runs when new or updated company shift is observed in Paylocity. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

paylocity_new_or_updated_employee_trigge.description: Runs when new or updated employee is observed in Paylocity. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

paylocity_new_or_updated_work_location_t.description: Runs when new or updated work location is observed in Paylocity. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

paylocity_new_work_location_trigger.description: Runs when new work location is observed in Paylocity. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.
